mil4.5:1.1: “Sir Nagasena, this stretch of ground is free of the eight faults that spoil a discussion, and I am the finest discussion partner in the world. I keep confidences, and I will keep them for as long as I live. My understanding has matured through eight reasons, and nowadays a student like me is hard to find. A teacher should treat a student who has entered rightly, rightly in accordance with those twenty-five qualities of a teacher that teachers have.
mil4.5:2.1: Here, sir Nagasena, a teacher should watch over a student constantly and unbrokenly, should know what to avoid and what to approach, should know the heedless and the heedful, should know the season, should know the sickness, should know whether food has been received or not, should know the difference, should share what has fallen into the bowl, should comfort him with, ‘Do not be afraid, benefit is coming to you’; should know the movement with, ‘This person is going about with that person’; should know the movement in the village, should know the movement in the monastery; he should not make joking with him, he should talk with him, he should put up with his faults when he sees them, he should act carefully, he should act without interruption, he should act without concealment, he should act leaving nothing in reserve, he should establish the mind of begetting with, ‘May I breed this person in the skills’; he should establish the mind of increase with, ‘so that this person does not decline!’; he should establish the mind with, ‘I will make this person strong through the power of training’; he should establish a mind of lovingkindness, he should not desert him in times of danger, he should not be slack in work that should be done, when he stumbles he should be helped up by the Dhamma.
mil4.5:2.2: These, sir, are the twenty-five qualities of a teacher. Please enter rightly in accordance with them. Sir, a doubt has arisen in me. There are the Mendaka questions proclaimed by the Conqueror; in the future there will be dispute about them, and in the future people with understanding like yours will be hard to find. Please give me eyes into these questions, to refute the objections”.
